# GridPanel { #anylumino.GridPanel }

```python
GridPanel(
    widgets=None,
    *,
    titles=None,
    keys=None,
    columns='1fr 1fr',
    rows='auto',
    gap=8,
    areas=None,
    width='100%',
    height=420,
    resizable=True,
)
```

CSS grid-backed Lumino panel for placing children in grid cells.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                     | Description                                                                                                                             | Default     |
|-----------|--------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| widgets   | iterable or mapping      | Child widgets or keyed child mapping.                                                                                                   | `None`      |
| titles    | iterable or mapping      | Optional labels associated with children.                                                                                               | `None`      |
| keys      | iterable of str          | Stable child keys for iterable ``widgets``.                                                                                             | `None`      |
| columns   | str                      | CSS ``grid-template-columns`` value.                                                                                                    | `"1fr 1fr"` |
| rows      | str                      | CSS ``grid-template-rows`` value.                                                                                                       | `"auto"`    |
| gap       | int, float, str, or None | CSS grid gap. Numeric values use shared anylumino size rules.                                                                           | `8`         |
| areas     | iterable of dict         | Per-child placement metadata. Each item can describe CSS grid placement such as row, column, or area values understood by the frontend. | `None`      |
| width     | int, float, str, or None | Widget width.                                                                                                                           | `'100%'`    |
| height    | int, float, str, or None | Widget height.                                                                                                                          | `420`       |
| resizable | bool                     | Whether the grid gets a notebook resize handle.                                                                                         | `True`      |

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
